name: microsoft-power-bi
label: Microsoft Power BI
description: Create and manage Power BI datasets and reports, and push data to them

export_report_to_file.label: Export Report to File
export_report_to_file.description: Exports a Power BI report to a PDF, PPTX, or PNG file.

workspace_id.label: Workspace
workspace_id.description: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).

report_id.label: Report
report_id.description: Select a report from the chosen workspace.

file_format.label: File Format
file_format.description: The format to export the report to.

max_wait_seconds.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
max_wait_seconds.description: How long to keep polling for the export to finish before giving up.

list_reports.label: List Reports
list_reports.description: Lists all reports in a Power BI workspace.

workspace_id.label: Workspace
workspace_id.description: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).

clone_report.label: Clone Report
clone_report.description: Creates a copy of a Power BI report, optionally into a different workspace or bound to a different dataset.

workspace_id.label: Workspace
workspace_id.description: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).

report_id.label: Report
report_id.description: Select a report from the chosen workspace.

new_report_name.label: New Report Name
new_report_name.description: The name to give the cloned report.

target_workspace_id.label: Target Workspace
target_workspace_id.description: Where to place the cloned report. Defaults to the same workspace as the source report.

target_dataset_id.label: Target Dataset ID
target_dataset_id.description: Optional. The ID of the dataset the cloned report should bind to (found in the dataset's Power BI portal URL, e.g. ".../datasets/{this-id}/details"). Leave blank to keep the source report's dataset.
